question: o09
q: Where is the ASX 200 sitting today?

transcript.answer:
I can't tell you where the ASX 200 is today. My tools don't include a share market or equity index feed. The one RBA table I searched (F7) covers business lending rates, and none of the other tools carry share prices. Any figure I gave you would be a guess, so I won't give one.

For a live level, try the ASX website (asx.com.au), the S&P Dow Jones Indices page for the S&P/ASX 200, or a broker or finance app such as Google Finance, Bloomberg or Market Index.

I can pull Australian macro and market-related data that often moves the index:
- the RBA cash rate
- the AUD exchange rate
- lending rates
- CPI
- labour force figures

Would any of those help?
